name: DEATH GUARD: DEATHSHROUD BODYGUARD
description: Deathshroud Terminators are swollen from the rotten powers of their diseased patron. With every swing of their giant scythes, they decapitate and disembowel their foes. They fight in ominous silence, embodying the inevitable onset of their enemies’ death and the inescapable judgement of Mortarion himself.</br></br>This multipart plastic kit builds three Deathshroud Terminators, elite bodyguards for your Death Guard armies in Warhammer 40,000. Clad in nigh-impenetrable Cataphractii plate, combined with the resilience granted them by their god, they are incredibly hard to kill as they silently march across the battlefield to reap their foes. Utterly lethal at close range, each is armed with a rusted and diseased manreaper – a large scythe that stands taller than the Deathshroud who brandish it – and a plaguespurt gauntlet to jet streams of unpleasant maladies at the unfortunate.</br></br>The kit builds an optional champion who has a choice of two different heads, and can be armed with a second plaguespurt gauntlet. He can be built with an empty fist or carrying a rusted Nurgle bell. The other two Deathshroud Terminators each have the choice of two different heads.</br></br>This kit comprises 51 plastic components, and 3x Citadel 40mm Round Bases. These miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
